about: Canonical gen-3 inputs and outputs, merged from the names the heads pass proposed (rules/heads/*.jsonl). Every name in an inputs_missing or a tagged outputs entry maps to exactly one entry below, or to covered or dropped. Apply with: python scripts/rules_catalogue.py gen3-fields. Source: snapshot = already recorded, only the input layout changes; record = already recorded, only a target is added; new = needs new collection.

extensions.what: zone_outcome gains values shuffled into library, to command zone, entered the battlefield (apart from blinked), ceased to exist; library_bottom gets set and phasing in stops reading as phased_out; library and exile cards get targets through in.library_cards and in.rel_exiled_with
the keyword vocabulary covers every Forge keyword, not 28
the counter vocabulary gains keyword counters and the other named kinds now in 'other'
each created group also carries its controller, subtypes, name, counters, and emblems and cards made outside the game
library_events gains shuffle, and the tutor and surveil bits get set by the events that mean them

planned.what: every line of a permanent as ability slots (snapshot section); also spliced lines, emblems' lines and lines as text-changing effects leave them
active player for every player and card (turn-rule section)
priority holder for every player and card (turn-rule section)
which attacker each blocker blocks (block-pairing section)
timing column of the legality verdict (turn-rule section)
one column per failed rules check (turn-rule section)

fixes.what: build-corpus keeps a permanent spell's resolution record, keyed to the permanent's card, instead of refusing it as acting through no text
turn-based actions (draw, cleanup discard, untap, untap-step phasing and day/night, lore counters, the attack-declaration tap) get a record instead of being discarded

covered.reason: every rule that lists it also lists the name that fixes it (new:permanent_spell_resolution, or new:created_objects for a token's X counters)

dropped.reason: subgames, restarts and control of another player, which the design leaves out
outside a two-player game without a sideboard, or Un-set and casual mechanics: Attractions, stickers, tickets, companions, sideboards, concession, the opening hand

engine procedure in the middle of an action, two rules or fewer: an activation or payment in progress, a turn ending, the order of pending extra turns, effect expiry, mana emptying, event and stack order as outputs, triggers ceasing
a characteristic the input already shows, with no change to predict: colour derived from mana cost, prototype and other set characteristics, a colour indicator
random results are given as inputs, not predicted
banding: one keyword from 1990s sets, eight rules of bookkeeping
one or two rules each, not worth a field: X as an output, counters paid as a cost, a choice made on resolution, an attachment no Forge card can illustrate
